ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity surface; macro-level ratio of approximately 15% high-intensity pixels (scars/mottling) to 85% low-intensity pixels (base pigmentation).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast vertical linear strips on the upper-medial left lobe. Contiguous mid-intensity grey mottled blobs localized in the basal and lower-mid sections of both lobes against a black background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 130 degrees and depth representing roughly 10% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular linear boundary. High-frequency serrations on distal tips. A significant irregular indentation (notch) located on the trailing edge of the left lobe near the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges of both lobes, tapering to sharply defined points at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of small, high-contrast circular spots on the far-left distal tip and along the upper-right margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct clusters of vertical, parallel high-intensity linear disruptions on the left lobe; one cluster of 5 lines and one cluster of 2 lines.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical parallel scarring (rake marks) on the left lobe and an irregular indentation on the left trailing edge consistent with physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Subtle diagonal low-intensity linear feature cutting through the mottling on the lower-right lobe.
